system.description:
The best way to support your team is from the air.

Assign one of the dice you rolled at the end of the power source step to the @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.5GDEdsr0jrDmWApP]{Flight} or @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle} power. If you already have one of them, either skip it or swap the die with one of your new dice.

Assign one or more remaining dice to any of these powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• Select from Athletic powers category

• Select from Mobility powers category

• Select from Technological powers category

Assign any remaining dice to any of these qualities:

• Select from Information qualities category

• Select from Physical qualities category

Gain two of the following Green abilities, at least one using your @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.5GDEdsr0jrDmWApP]{Flight} or @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle} power:

Gain one of the above abilities at Yellow.

Choose an Ideals principle.

Roll for personality selection.
